rows.summary: Current research prioritizes the synthesis of value acquisition mechanisms in reinforcement learning. While divergent value acquisition projects remain synthesis-ready, attention constraints necessitate a focus on responsibility formation. Existing active projects on memory-formed preferences and persistent identity have been re-evaluated.
